name: awesome-public-real-time-datasets
desc: A list of publicly available datasets with real-time data maintained by the team at bytewax.io

resources.name: Coinbase Market Data
resources.desc: Coinbase websocket to market data including level 2 orderbook data.

resources.name: Blockchain transactions
resources.desc: Provides real-time notifications about new transactions and blocks.

resources.name: Finnhub
resources.desc: Limited free usage with a premium data sources also available.

resources.name: CoinCheck
resources.desc: a cryptocurrency API that has a WebSocket interface (in beta)

resources.name: SEC EDGAR
resources.desc: The SEC offers real-time streaming access to regulatory filings (like 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) as well as real-time XBRL financial data via RESTful APIs and RSS feeds.

resources.name: FilingFirehose
resources.desc: Real-time parsed SEC EDGAR filings via REST. Body-text-classified 8-Ks (catches buried cyber and officer-departure events), activist-tagged Schedule 13D/G, ATM-offering detection in S-3 / 424B5. Free public tier covers last 72h, no API key.

resources.name: Binance
resources.desc: WebSocket API that delivers real-time cryptocurrency trading data and order book updates

resources.name: OANDA
resources.desc: HTTP based FOREX rates stream through the OANDA API.

resources.name: CoinCap
resources.desc: Provides real-time pricing and market activity for over 1,000 cryptocurrencies

resources.name: Polygon.io
resources.desc: Provides real‑time stock market and cryptocurrency data from all US exchanges via REST and WebSocket endpoints.

resources.name: FinancialData.Net
resources.desc: Stock market data, financial statements, insider and institutional trading data, sustainability data, earnings releases, and much more.

resources.name: CoinPaprika
resources.desc: Cryptocurrency market data API with real-time prices, OHLCV, and tickers for 12,000+ coins. Free tier, no API key required.

resources.name: DexPaprika
resources.desc: DEX data API with pool data, token prices, OHLCV, trade history, and SSE streaming across 36 chains. Free tier, no signup to start, data delayed up to 15s.

resources.name: Pyth Network
resources.desc: Delivers financial market data across every asset class through one API.

resources.name: Sharpe
resources.desc: Real-time crypto market data API covering funding, derivatives, arbitrage, narratives, listings, and news.

resources.name: Agent Gateway
resources.desc: Free REST API for real-time prices of 500+ crypto tokens via Hyperliquid. No API key required. Poll GET /prices for live market data.

resources.name: OpenChainBench
resources.desc: Open benchmarks of crypto infrastructure (RPC providers, bridges, oracles, L1 finality, prediction-market data, Hyperliquid builders) refreshed every minute via a JSON feed, with daily Parquet snapshots on Hugging Face (CC-BY-4.0) archived on Zenodo. [[DOI]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20800311)

resources.name: Korean Market Data
resources.desc: Daily foreign and institutional net flows for every KOSPI/KOSDAQ common stock (2,555 names) plus all 44 KRX sector indices, rebuilt after each Korean market close. English CSV/JSON over raw HTTP, no key. CC BY 4.0, archived on Zenodo [[DOI]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21833374).

resources.name: CoinNudge
resources.desc: Crypto market-research datasets over HTTP: free no-key JSON/CSV snapshots for market breadth, funding, open interest, liquidations and listings, plus a daily event-study release with self-service keys or Parquet files.

resources.name: 0xArchive
resources.desc: Real-time Hyperliquid and Lighter market data via REST and WebSocket, with historical data also available. Permanent no-card free tier.

resources.name: Eulerpool
resources.desc: Streaming stock quotes (trades, NBBO, 1-second bars, L2) over WebSocket wss://stream.eulerpool.com/v1/subscribe and SSE, plus a REST API for fundamentals, ETFs, macro, crypto and FX. Free keys receive delayed 1-second aggregates; paid keys get live ticks.

resources.name: Adanos
resources.desc: Near-real-time stock and crypto sentiment from Reddit, X, financial news, and Polymarket via REST, with a free API tier.

resources.name: ADSBiq
resources.desc: Community-powered real-time aircraft positions over WebSocket. Sends an initial snapshot followed by sequence-numbered deltas, with optional geographic subscriptions; free access requires no API key.

resources.name: Open Rail Data
resources.desc: A collection of APIs that provide data relating to the UK rail network, including reference data, train timetables, and live service updates. The live data is streamed using the STOMP protocol.

resources.name: GBFS New York
resources.desc: GBFS is the standard for bike share data with many locations around the world. Find more information here

resources.name: Open Sky Flight
resources.desc: Data from Open Sky Api via HTTP endpoint. Supports real-time, but not streaming. Need to continually poll.

resources.name: Open Glider Network
resources.desc: The OGN provides real-time traffic for gliders and other light aircraft. You can use an OGN client like python-ogn-client to connect to OGN servers, parse the APRS messages and push them to a broker like Kafka for streaming processing.

resources.name: MTA GTFS Feed
resources.desc: Transit data in GTFS format for transit systems like NYC subway and Caltrain.

resources.name: NY 511 live camera data
resources.desc: This live camera data requires some scraping to use. From this list of cameras you can then source the individual camera id and then request the timestamped image or most recent image by building the url like - https://511ny.org/map/Cctv/<image-id-goes-here>

resources.name: Transport for London (TfL)
resources.desc: live data about the tube, buses, and more

resources.name: Norwegian Coastal Administration
resources.desc: AIS data from vessels within the Norwegian economic zone and the protection zones off Svalbard and Jan Mayen. (https://www.kystverket.no/en/sea-transport-and-ports/ais/access-to-ais-data/)

resources.name: German Traffic Data
resources.desc: German real-time traffic information

resources.name: Swiss Traffic & Public Transport Data
resources.desc: Various real-time transport data from Switzerland such road traffic, status of EV charging stations, shared mobility services and live arrivals/departures of public transport

resources.name: Transport for NSW API
resources.desc: Real‑time public transport data (buses, trains, ferries) available for New South Wales, Australia

resources.name: Ireland National Transport Authority
resources.desc: Real-time update stream for services provided by Dublin Bus, Bus Éireann, and Go-Ahead Ireland.

resources.name: LiveTrafficCam
resources.desc: Live US state DOT traffic camera data as JSON: cameras by state or mountain pass with verified live status from rolling HTTP checks, plus measured per-state camera uptime. No auth.

resources.name: Open Weather API
resources.desc: Current weather data available free at rate of 1 request per ~90 seconds (only first 1000 API calls per day are free).

resources.name: Clima Cell
resources.desc: Real-time weather data in a free or paid API.

resources.name: NOAA Buoy Data
resources.desc: Real-time buoy data from NOAA

resources.name: NOAA Weather Data
resources.desc: Live Weather Data API from NOAA

resources.name: ENSO Historical Dataset
resources.desc: Monthly ENSO data (1950-2026), 126 records with ONI/SOI/subsurface anomalies, CSV+JSON, CC0.

resources.name: ENSO Tracker Dashboard
resources.desc: Real-time El Niño/La Niña monitoring. ONI, SOI, trade winds, and subsurface temps from NOAA/BOM/ECMWF, updated daily.

resources.name: Redfin Realestate
resources.desc: pull up to date data from redfin unofficial API.

resources.name: EPA Airnow data
resources.desc: Air quality data hosted by the EPA.

resources.name: UK Flood Data
resources.desc: UK government real-time API for flood data.

resources.name: ZipCheckup
resources.desc: Free REST API for ZIP-level environmental safety data across the US: water quality, air quality, PFAS contamination, radon, lead, flood risk, and 11 more verticals. Covers 42,000+ ZIP codes. No API key required. CC BY 4.0.

resources.name: US Energy Grid Data
resources.desc: Real-time grid information for the US energy grid

resources.name: DC Hub Grid Prices
resources.desc: Free, no-key REST endpoint (https://api.dchub.cloud/api/v1/lmp/prices) returning live 5-minute real-time LMPs for CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, PJM and SPP, with per-hub detail at /api/v1/iso-lmp/snapshot. Part of DC Hub, the live data layer for data-center site selection; the same data is available to AI agents over MCP at https://dchub.cloud/mcp.

resources.name: USGS Earthquake Real-time Feed
resources.desc: Live seismological data feed to know about earthquakes as they happen

resources.name: News API
resources.desc: Aggregator that pulls headlines and articles from dozens of news outlets worldwide in near real time via API. It offers a free tier (with rate limits)

resources.name: New York Times Newswire API
resources.desc: The Times Newswire API provides an up-to-the-minute stream of articles published on NYTimes.com.

resources.name: GDELT 2.0 Event Database
resources.desc: Collection of all events happening everywhere in the world, with emotional valence estimation, realtime translations.

resources.name: Jobven
resources.desc: Job postings read directly from employer career pages and applicant tracking systems, with webhook events when a role opens, changes or closes. Free tier of 300 jobs a month, and one sample endpoint needs no key.

resources.name: CrustAPI
resources.desc: Live Google News, web search and Maps results as structured JSON, fetched on every request. Free tier of 3,000 credits per month, no credit card.

resources.name: LottoLens PH PCSO Draw Results
resources.desc: Free, no-key JSON feed of independently compiled Philippine PCSO draw results, refreshed after scheduled draws are source-verified. Poll over HTTP; records include draw date, draw time, and source URL.

resources.name: Longevity World Cup
resources.desc: Live public biological-age competition dataset with athlete profiles, biomarker records, proof links, placements, and crowd-age fields. Free JSON over HTTP; no API key required.

resources.name: Urgences Québec
resources.desc: Live stretcher occupancy and waiting-room counts for every emergency room in Quebec, refreshed from the ministry feed every 15 minutes. JSON over HTTP with no API key needed, and there's an hourly history endpoint per hospital back to August 2026.

resources.name: AlertX Outbreak Signal Clusters
resources.desc: Clusters of outbreak-shaped public health signals worldwide, rebuilt hourly, with syndrome and disease triage, confidence scores, and whether an official health authority later confirmed the event. Free JSON over HTTP, no API key required; aggregated to WHO region.

resources.name: ThingSpeak IoT Public Channels
resources.desc: Crowdsourced IoT channels of users publishing various IoT sensor data in real-time. Accessible via REST API or MQTT API.

resources.name: Sensor.Community
resources.desc: 15,000+ air quality sensors worldwide, REST API.

resources.name: Certstream
resources.desc: Certstream provides a publicly accessible real‐time feed of certificate transparency logs, delivering live updates on SSL/TLS certificate issuance as it occurs.

resources.name: Free CertStream API
resources.desc: Free hosted WebSocket stream of newly issued TLS certificates and their domain names from Certificate Transparency logs, at wss://api.certstream.dev/. No API key required.

resources.name: URLhaus
resources.desc: Community-driven repository for real-time malicious URL data, offering actionable threat intelligence to block phishing and malware.

resources.name: CISA Automated Indicator Sharing (AIS)
resources.desc: US government-led service that enables public and private organizations to exchange machine-readable threat indicators in real time.

resources.name: Open Threat Exchange (OTX)
resources.desc: Community-driven threat intelligence platform that streams real-time data on malicious IPs, domains, and URL through the OTX DirectConnect API.

resources.name: Shodan Streaming API
resources.desc: Real-time feed of devices/banners discovered on the internet. Free tier available.

resources.name: GreyNoise Community API
resources.desc: Free IP intelligence lookups for identifying mass scanners and background noise on the internet.

resources.name: Lenses Datagen
resources.desc: Open-source (Apache 2.0) synthetic streaming data generator by Lenses.io. Publishes to Kafka, Pulsar, or any target system. Ships with rich built-in datasets including sea vessel position reports (AIS), NYC taxi trips, telecom Italia network data, IoT device temperature readings, and more.

resources.name: Mockingbird by Tinybird
resources.desc: Open-source mock streaming data generator. Pairs well with EventSim which is already listed.

resources.name: SSE.dev
resources.desc: Public SSE test endpoint with configurable intervals. Useful for streaming pipeline testing.

resources.name: AI Detector Arena
resources.desc: Live leaderboard and benchmark dataset for evaluating AI-generated image detectors. Real-time rankings updated as new detectors are evaluated against 2,038 images across 17 AI generators. Data accessible via HTTP API. [[DOI]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18620634)

resources.name: World Cup 2026 Tour
resources.desc: Free HTTP API for current 2026 World Cup match-day fixtures, next-match polling, RSS, and calendar feeds. No API key required.

resources.name: Live Tennis API
resources.desc: Live match state for ATP, WTA, Challenger and ITF over REST: sets, games, points, who is serving and tiebreak flag, plus fixtures and results. Free tier requires a key but no card (30 requests/minute, 100/day); the WebSocket push feed is a paid tier. Open studies dataset (CC BY 4.0) at https://livetennisapi.com/open-tennis-data

resources.name: Lichess TV Feed
resources.desc: Live chess games streamed as NDJSON (https://lichess.org/api/tv/feed) or SSE, per channel (blitz, bullet, rapid, etc.). No authentication. Full game history available under CC0 at database.lichess.org.

resources.name: MLB Stats API
resources.desc: Unofficial access to MLB's live game feed with pitch-by-pitch play data (statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/{gamePk}/feed/live), plus a diffPatch endpoint for incremental updates. No key.

resources.name: NHL Web API
resources.desc: Undocumented JSON API behind NHL.com (api-web.nhle.com/v1) for live scores, schedules and play-by-play. No key; endpoints may change between seasons.

resources.name: football-data.org
resources.desc: REST API for fixtures, results and standings across 12 major football competitions on a permanent free tier (10 calls/min, delayed scores); live scores on paid tiers.

resources.name: Betfair Exchange Stream API
resources.desc: Push-based stream of betting exchange prices across football, tennis, horse racing and more. Free delayed key for development; requires a Betfair account.

resources.name: The Odds API
resources.desc: Live and upcoming odds from multiple bookmakers across many sports via REST. Free tier of 500 requests per month.

resources.name: US National Parks Live Status (Park Atlas)
resources.desc: Live alerts, entrance fees, reservation requirements, webcams, and conditions for all 474 US National Park System units, aggregated nightly from official federal APIs. Bulk CSV snapshots: park-atlas-data. No key required.

resources.name: GitHub Events
resources.desc: Use the GitHub API to consume public events happening on GitHub.

resources.name: EventSim
resources.desc: Tool to simulate event data

resources.name: Formula 1 Stats & Telemetry
resources.desc: Python package that provides an easy-to-use API into live and historical F1 data.

resources.name: International Space Station Live Data
resources.desc: More about the project on GitHub https://github.com/ISS-Mimic/Mimic

resources.name: Live Satellite Positions
resources.desc: N2YO.COM allows tracking of satellites through REST API with the NORAD catalog number assigned by the United States Space Command.

resources.name: Hacker News
resources.desc: Near real-time news feed from Hacker News for tech and startup-related topics.

resources.name: Bluesky
resources.desc: Firehose is an authenticated stream of events on the protocol that underlies Bluesky, enabling efficient syncing of user updates via a WebSocket connection.

resources.name: SpaceX API
resources.desc: Open-source REST API for SpaceX launches, rockets, capsules, landing pads.

resources.name: OpenF1
resources.desc: Free and open-source API for real-time and historical Formula 1 data, including telemetry, lap timings, race control messages, weather, pit stops, team radio, and standings

resources.name: Data Bento
resources.desc: Data Bento provides low-latency market data from many exchanges in several schemas. Access over Raw API, which uses a binary protocol over TCP, and our HTTP API. They also provide client libraries for Rust, Python, and C++.

resources.name: IEX Trading
resources.desc: IEX was created in response to questionable trading practices that had become widely used across traditional exhcanges! Their API provides streaming Stock market data.

resources.name: NYSE Cloud Streaming
resources.desc: Provides real-time access to high-quality NYSE exchange data feeds, streaming directly in the cloud using Kafka format.

resources.name: Alpha Vantage Market News & Sentiment
resources.desc: Live market news & sentiment data from selected news outlets covering stocks, cryptocurrencies, forex, and a wide range of topics such as fiscal policy, mergers & acquisitions, IPOs, etc.

resources.name: Bloomberg
resources.desc: The Bloomberg Market Data Feed (B-PIPE) provides consolidated, normalized market data in real time.

resources.name: Kaspersky Threat Data Feeds
resources.desc: Kaspersky Threat Data Feeds deliver continuously updated, real‐time threat intelligence by aggregating data from diverse sources.

resources.name: Bitdefender Threat Intelligence Feeds
resources.desc: A comprehensive suite of real-time, curated threat data streams that deliver actionable insights on malicious domains, IP addresses, URLs, file hashes, and vulnerabilities.

resources.name: ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Feeds
resources.desc: Near real-time feeds generated from interactive malware sandbox sessions, providing deep insights into malware behaviors and associated indicators of compromise (IoCs).

resources.name: Deepinfo Data Feeds
resources.desc: Real-time updates on domain registrations, subdomain discoveries, and DNS changes accesible via REST-based web services.

resources.name: FlightAware Firehose
resources.desc: Real-time data feed of global aircraft ADS-B positions and flight status.

resources.name: Spire Data Services
resources.desc: Global maritime vessel tracking, combining Satellite automatic identification systems (AIS), Terrestrial AIS, and Dynamic AIS.

resources.name: PurpleAir Air Quality Data
resources.desc: Developer API for accessing purple air sensor data.

resources.name: NewsAPI
resources.desc: NewsAPI tracks headlines in 7 categories across over 50 countries, and at over a hundred top publications and blogs, in near real time. Free developer version with 24 delays available.

resources.name: X (Twitter)
resources.desc: X provides a streaming interface for research or enterprise.

resources.name: Xquik
resources.desc: REST and MCP access for X/Twitter search, profiles, followers, monitors, webhooks, and bulk extraction workflows.

resources.name: Bing News Search API
resources.desc: Bing News Search API returns fresh news results from various sources in near real time

resources.name: Reuters News API
resources.desc: Low latency news feed from Reuters

resources.name: webz.io
resources.desc: webz.io provides API with real-time information from thousands of news sites, blogs, and discussion forums.

resources.name: Mediastack
resources.desc: JSON API delivering worldwide news, headlines and blog articles in real-time

resources.name: Sports Livescores
resources.desc: Developer API of TheSportsDB that gives you access to livescores

resources.name: Sportradar Sports Data
resources.desc: Global live data of 80 sports, 500 sport leagues and 750k events a year (free 30 day trial available)
